reviewed_candidate.scope: source snapshot inspected; later source revisions require separate disposition

correctly_implemented_in_snapshot: Fixed actual source row indices preserve paired reference and tariff arrays
Thermal-reference price product is labelled proxy units, not actual policy bill
Hard day mass and reference energy plus explicit native-unit moment bands
L1 weight displacement objective and visible nonuniqueness
Original-unit raw-product residual checks separate from LP epigraph rows
Infeasibility returns no weights and row envelopes are explicitly only necessary
Explicit calendar/provenance admission responsibility of caller
No dispatch, dynamic-feasibility or out-of-sample claim

issues.problem: Finite raw daily totals do not imply finite D*max(selected daily coefficient), attainable endpoints or weighted estimates. An infinite numerical scale can erase the energy equality and make an infinite residual pass via inf <= inf.

static_arithmetic: All raw power entries, daily energies [1e308,0] and full target 1e308 pass the existing raw finite-total checks.
The normalized energy row and target both become 0; only day conservation forces w=2.
Raw weighted energy estimate is +Infinity; residual and numerical allowance are both +Infinity.
The existing comparison violation <= allowance evaluates True for Infinity <= Infinity.
diagnose_decision_weights can therefore mark this supplied invalid-weight certificate passes=True; no LP invocation is needed to expose the validation path.

issues.risk_limit: Extreme synthetic magnitudes, not observed heating-case values. This is a finite-input validation hole, not evidence that current engineering results are wrong.
minimal_fix: Reject nonfinite or nonpositive numerical scales before constructing constraints.
Reject nonfinite attainable endpoints, native estimates/residuals/allowances/violations and diagnostic objective before any acceptance comparison.
Independent diagnostic must fail or raise on nonfinite arithmetic, even when inputs and supplied weights are finite.
Return standard finite JSON diagnostics; do not serialize Infinity as a passing certificate.
issues.acceptance: Analytical direct-diagnostic fixture above rejects/fails; solver entry rejects before linprog; existing realistic and product-overflow fixtures still pass with documented statuses.
issues.requested_gate: Resolve or constrain/document supported magnitude domain before method freeze; parent owns feedback and integration.

issues.problem: Existing hard method minimizes W1; new method minimizes L1 displacement while adding price/window constraints. A whole-candidate comparison cannot isolate price pairing from changed objective and other windows.
issues.minimal_fix: If claiming a price-pairing mechanism, predeclare an energy-only L1 control and price-only/window-only ablations on identical dates/bounds and budget. Otherwise limit claim to combined-candidate performance and do not attribute improvement to price moments alone.
issues.scope_note: No new solver implementation requested from reviewer; this is a parent protocol choice before confirmation.

issues.problem: Module calendar IDs and native moment bands are deliberately supplied by caller. Exact untouched window identities, time pairing, thresholds, policy/ties and end-to-end budget are not certified by the module or this review record.
issues.minimal_fix: Parent locks A final hashes and B admission manifests, exact masks/units/bands, unchanged policy library/service/state/budgets, deterministic weight outcome convention and all failure metrics before opening confirmation outcomes. Raw whole-window exogenous planning inputs may be used under explicit offline scope; full policy outcome targets may not be used to fit deployable weights.
issues.acceptance: Prospective signed/hashed parent protocol with no pending decision-sensitive fields, all exposed development and confirmation overlap declared; no silent repair of unsuccessful cases.
issues.reason_for_priority: Required experimental gate, not an accusation of existing leakage or a request for unavailable SCADA.

not_confirmed_as_bugs: Zero reference is correctly valid for this L1 method because it does not normalize by mean; existing W1 comparator may separately be undefined.
Signed prices and empty/overlapping masks are explicitly supported by design; their targets/units must be retained.
L1 multiple optima are disclosed; an a priori fixed solver/row order and preserved weights can be sufficient, while post-result choosing a preferred optimum is prohibited.
Timestamp checking belongs to admitted caller; absent parsing in this numeric module is not by itself a bug.
No W1 objective/output in the new module is not a missing feature; common evaluator can measure W1 independently.
